title: The cylinder
content: I’m not sure if this is appropriate for the mall world sub, but as it mentions, it doesn’t have to be a mall. I figured I would share some of my dream recollections and see if anyone experienced anything similar. There’s a school and in the center of the campus is a very tall cylinder. I’m talking 20 floors at least, and there are classrooms spiraling in a kind of corkscrew pattern around the edge of the cylinder. There’s also an elevator that is segmented into three different wedges so there’s three different cars, but they fit together like half of a pie chart. The cylinder is in the center of the campus of the school, but it is next to a freeway ramp. The overpass next to these ramps is impossible as the freeway has ramps going both up and down, but you’re on the ground level and the down ramps are not going underground. I don’t know how to describe it. Near the campus, there are some derelict buildings that you can get into through hold in the walls or ajar doors. The interior is just complete and utter urban decay. It’s winding and maze like, and leads to this almost sewerscape and if you follow the sewers for long enough, you end up coming out of the emergency exit of a movie theater directly into an auditorium. There is a merch booth at the bottom left corner of the screen where you can buy things like t-shirts, albums, hoodies and the like. Anyone else been to the cylinder? I have at least half a dozen times in my dreams…
